identity_cost.detail: a verified email address, a full name and a Discord or Telegram handle: the claim form asks for 'Name - your full name, Email address - the address where your verification code will be sent, Discord or Telegram handle' plus four profile questions, then sends a 6-digit code with a 10-minute expiry. Signing in with email, Google or a passkey creates a smart wallet automatically, so no crypto wallet is needed. No card and no hold: the grant pays in COMPY. Paid jobs are funded in USDC or COMPY from an escrow balance, and whether a debit or prepaid card is accepted is not stated.
